task: Evolve the existing Template Factory visual-DNA/recipe authority into one canonical immutable Template Genome contract that becomes the upstream identity and constraint input for later Type System, Constraint Planner, Media Planner, distinctness, lineage and dynamic compiler hardening.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Brabus revalidation proved that per-template visual DNA exists but is ad hoc and not a single versioned immutable Factory authority. Constraint planning, media planning, distinctness, lineage and compiler work would otherwise bind to unstable template-local shapes and be rewritten later.
observableOutcomes: One canonical Template Genome contract owns template identity grammar, tokens, composition, media language, responsive behavior, exclusions, inheritance metadata, version and deterministic immutable hash.
Factory generator-ready recipes fail closed when Genome is missing, stale, malformed or does not match blueprint/template identity.
Compiled Factory lineage carries Genome identity/hash without copying another template's concrete media or visual identity.
Existing Page Schema, Runtime, Builder, recipe, visual authority and Template Factory remain the sole authorities; no parallel generator or gate is created.
Loot Vault v2 acts only as an existing accepted canary declaration for the generic Genome contract; Template #3 remains forbidden.
unresolvedRisks: A Genome that stores concrete media paths would couple identity to assets and undermine the later Media Planner.
A shallow freeze or unchecked stored digest could permit silent post-definition drift.
A Genome contract that is too generic would become documentation rather than compiler input; one that is too template-specific would recreate clone skins.

in: Canonical immutable Template Genome contract and validation.
Deterministic content hash and controlled evolution lineage metadata.
Factory recipe and Generator Readiness integration.
Adversarial tests for missing, identity-drifted, mutated and concrete-media-contaminated genomes.
out: Template Type System and Constraint Planner implementation.
New Control Plane gates or parallel completion systems.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Genome becomes an upstream production authority consumed by several later Brabus capabilities. The highest practical assurance is a versioned deterministic immutable schema with fail-closed validation, identity binding, lineage rules and adversarial mutation/media-leak tests integrated into existing Factory readiness.

acceptanceCriteria: Genome has one canonical versioned executable contract under builder-template-system.
All required Brabus Genome dimensions are explicit and non-empty.
Genome hash is deterministic over canonical content and cannot be accepted stale.
Genome identity matches Factory recipe and Blueprint template identity.
Genome contains semantic media language/roles only; concrete src/referenceSrc asset paths are rejected.
Generator-ready Factory recipes require valid Genome evidence.
Factory provenance exposes Genome id/version/hash for downstream lineage.
FACTORY-TEMPLATE-GENOME may become PROVEN only with canonical implementation plus adversarial executable tests.
invariants: One Page Schema, Runtime, Builder and Template Factory authority remain.
Genome governs constraints/identity but never owns commerce truth or arbitrary source code.
Concrete media remains in Media Manifest/Planner authority, not Genome.
Template-specific identity cannot be inherited silently from another template.
UNKNOWN, malformed or stale Genome evidence never counts as ready.

failureModes: Later planners compile against ad hoc VISUAL_DNA constants and require rewrite.
Genome claims immutability while nested objects remain mutable or digest is not recomputed.
Genome embeds media URLs and clones concrete identity across templates.
Factory reports generator-ready with a missing or mismatched Genome.
edgeCases: Two semantically identical genomes declared with different object-key order must hash identically.
Hash changes on any semantic dimension change.
Controlled evolution may name a parent hash but cannot alter current template identity.
Legacy recipes without Blueprint remain usable for scaffold tests but are not generator-ready.

alternatives.summary: Canonicalize Template Genome before downstream planners/compiler.
alternatives.reason: It is the common upstream contract for Type System, constraints, media semantics, distinctness and lineage.
Type-derived constraints would have no stable template identity/grammar target and would need rebinding.
Builder operations are already a proven base; Factory production planning has the higher rewrite-avoidance leverage now.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing recipe/Blueprint/scaffold is the correct owner path.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add Genome as a canonical Factory input, not a new subsystem.

specialistReviews.finding: Stored identity metadata without deterministic validation can drift.
specialistReviews.resolution: Recompute canonical hash and fail closed on mismatch/identity drift.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing VISUAL_DNA is valuable but underspecified and asset-adjacent.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve semantic grammar while explicitly forbidding concrete media paths.

challenge.scenario: Genome changes spacing grammar after hash creation.
challenge.resolution: Validation recomputes hash from canonical content.

challenge.finding: Concrete identity/media cloning contaminates reusable grammar.
challenge.resolution: Reject path/URL-like values inside Genome media grammar and exclusions.

challenge.scenario: Genome templateKey/version differs from recipe or Blueprint.
Object key order differs but semantics are identical.
challenge.finding: Naive JSON stringify creates unstable hashes.
challenge.resolution: Canonical recursive key sorting before digest.

proofPlan: Unit/adversarial proof for canonical hash stability, mutation sensitivity, deep freeze and required dimensions.
Fail-closed proof for media-path contamination, missing Genome and template identity drift.
Generator Readiness integration proof using Loot Vault v2 existing accepted recipe.
Production maturity proof promotion only after executable implementation and tests exist.
Normal CI + exact-head Template Factory Quality Gate v2 + Completion Truth.

requirements.requirement: Canonical immutable Template Genome is executable Factory authority with deterministic identity/hash and full required dimension coverage.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No second Factory/Builder/Runtime authority or gate is created.

requirements.requirement: Missing, stale, mutated, identity-drifted or concrete-media-contaminated Genome cannot produce generator readiness.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Generator readiness cannot pass invalid Genome evidence.
